baseline_prompt: A shopper has a 25% welcome coupon, a 15% employee discount, a $10 loyalty credit, and free shipping on a clearance item with only 8% margin. What is the best checkout recommendation?
expected_bad_answer: Apply every discount, use the loyalty credit, and add free shipping because the customer has all of them.
expected_corrected_answer: Choose the single best eligible discount, preserve the margin floor, and avoid free shipping when policy or margin rules disallow it.
extraction_prompt: Extract promotion eligibility, stacking constraints, margin floor, item type, and recommended checkout actions.
failure_class: promotion stacking and margin policy violation
guardrail_summary: Promotion recommendations must obey non-stackable coupon rules and margin thresholds.
repair_template: Your previous answer failed these promotion policy checks: {findings}. Revise the recommendation so discounts are eligible, non-stackable offers are not combined, and the margin floor is preserved.
title: Coupon Stack Policy Guardrail
